reason: A local image-reading and document-to-image plugin for text-only models, providing pixel analysis, OCR, image utilities, optional external VLM analysis, and document conversion.

summaries.zh: 为纯文本模型提供本地图片扫描、OCR、裁剪、取色、对比及文档转图片能力，并可选接入外部视觉模型。
summaries.en: Provides text-only models with local image scanning, OCR, cropping, palette extraction, comparison, and document-to-image conversion, with optional external vision-model support.

capabilities: Performs local pixel analysis and OCR
Crops, compares, samples, and extracts image palettes
Converts PDF and office documents to PNG images using local dependencies
Can send image data to an optional OpenAI-compatible external vision API
Writes exported images and settings to local storage
